titulo_video: The Inheritor - Chapter 7: The Inheritance Dilemma

locucoes.text: Joo Inhyuk is an heir trying to hide his secrets, but now he's cornered by Noh Yeseul, who just asked him a direct question.
Whoa...
The girl insists on knowing if he really chose that path, leaving our boy visibly tense.
Asked 'which' instead...
Then she leans forward, wanting to get closer than ever.
You saw it, right?
She smiles with a gleam in her eyes that already gives away exactly what she wants.
Mine...
The two get so close you can feel the tension from here, good lord.
The proximity is so intense that the heavy atmosphere settles in a single second.
It's one of those intense scenes where we don't know whether to watch or look away.
But check out this chapter title that promises to heat things up.
Her hand touches our boy, who's already shaking with nervousness.
This time,
Don't you want to show me?
Your...
Desire.
The guy gets a huge shock from all this boldness he didn't even expect.
But suddenly, we notice the boxes scattered in the corner of that chaotic room.
The dude grips the table so hard his knuckles turn white.
She keeps staring firmly at him, wanting to find out what his next move will be.
He thinks this woman and that girl are completely changing his life.
It's an electrifying scene with the two almost touching, you know?
She makes this sudden gesture of interaction, leaving the atmosphere even more confusing.
The man has a dark look, clearly frustrated with all this.
He stares at the girl with clenched fists, looking ready to destroy everything.
Then he moves quickly, suddenly asking what she's doing there.
The guy walks away in a hurry across the wooden floor, wanting to get out of that place.
But he ends up bumping into her, and she falls sitting on the floor, oh my god.
Kyah!?
He stands there with his back turned, completely paralyzed, not knowing how to react.
Sorry, I didn't mean to do that.
Our boy just watches the scene of her there in the back of the room.
Then a loud impact sound is heard in the environment, what a scare!
She quickly looks forward, all nervous about the turn of events.
Suddenly, the sky opens in unknown geometric shapes that defy reality.
The scene changes to this blue light effect, showing that the mystical atmosphere has arrived.
Even the clouds take on bizarre geometric shapes in the sky, way too strange, right?
We then see someone sitting alone on the park bench, surrounded by trees.
The person has their eyes closed, hands together in a deep moment of reflection.
Up in the blue sky, a text mysteriously appears explaining what's happening.
It says he thought his life was perfectly normal, but it's nothing like that.
Our protagonist then returns to work at the office, sitting in front of the computer.
He answers the phone, but his eyes can't leave the girl who arrives.
He just stays there watching, while the caption narrates excerpts from their marriage.
Just imagine the scene of the two looking at the newborn baby in the hospital, what a moment.
Even the elderly couple on the bench, watching the sunset, seems like a distant memory.
Normal.
The young man sits on the bench again, reflecting on the meaning of this so-called normality.
And suddenly the screen darkens with those vertical lines, things are about to go down now.
Physical contact is immediate, and someone says he can't keep living like this.
Then a muffled sound comes out, like the pressure of everything is rising to the max.
The hug tightens as he tries to contain the girl at all costs.
We now see a solitary figure with their back turned in a quite dark environment.
Someone warns backstage that it's not going to happen, it's out of the question.
They're right there together, keeping the super intense atmosphere between them.
The same person keeps talking, wanting to understand why he's acting this way.
It's another heavy contact scene where you can even see the texture of the clothes.
Another frame loaded with tension, cutting through the air between them.
Just like me.
The guy is in total shock because he finally realized the obvious resemblance.
The impact is so strong there's even a sound effect in the air, how crazy.
Someone screams for help in desperation, calling for the father figure.
Our boy opens his arms, all startled by what he just witnessed.
He sits on the park bench, now at night, breathing with great difficulty.
He silently wonders if everything he's experiencing is really real.
A dream...?
Then suddenly a water noise starts, heralding a heavy rain.
The director gives a close-up of his face, sweaty and super tense, good lord.
We see someone at the stove, calmly stirring a stew with a ladle.
You can hear hurried footsteps walking quickly across the house floor.
The person watches the stew as it keeps boiling there in the pot.
Suddenly, a loud noise makes the person in the kitchen jump in surprise.
The guy arrives panting and bent over, looking like he just ran a marathon.
I thought you might be hungry, so I made dinner with what was at home...
He grabs the girl out of nowhere, making the ladle fall to the floor, oh my god.
The food ends up flying everywhere in the middle of that sudden confusion.
She looks at him, all flushed and surprised by that such unexpected contact.
Yeah, right...
This inheritance thing, or being the owner, all of this...
All of this is too complicated, I can't take it anymore!
I accept.
Really?
Yes.
The two keep staring at each other, still maintaining that cautious distance, you know?
Someone asks what's happening there outside the main frame.
A question mark floats in the air, leaving us curious about their answer.
Our boy remains very flushed and apprehensive about what she'll say.
The girl stays still in the kitchen, serene, seeming to ignore the tension of the moment.
He can't take his eyes off her, maintaining a serious and tense expression.
She looks up with those big wide eyes, waiting for the next step.
The guy in the gray hoodie crosses his arms, trying to hold back his own embarrassment.
First...
She gets very attentive and worried, until she hears a signal coming from outside.
I want to see properly.
The frame focuses on her plaid clothes, oh boy, what could he want to see?
Her face is turned to the side and super flushed, what a cute scene.
She unties the bow of her own clothes, murmuring that it's okay.
The fabric finally falls, and the temperature of the atmosphere rises even more, oh my god.
There are the blue and white clothes stretched over the surface.
The pot keeps boiling on the stove, as steam instantly rises.
He adjusts his shirt collar and a dry impact sound echoes, how tense.
The pressure cooker whistles loudly, releasing steam in all directions.
Our guy crosses his arms again, looking to the side to avoid her.
A mysterious figure then starts unbuttoning their own shirt, damn.
He continues with his arms crossed, desperately trying to disguise his nervousness.
He says today is different from yesterday, that the previous day was just chance.
The two stare at each other intensely, as the atmosphere reaches its critical point.
The person takes off their clothes completely, standing barefoot right in the middle of the room.
She closes her eyes as if finding the end of embarrassment, geez.
She walks covering herself to maintain the pose in the intense scene, smiling at the end, huh?
